newsitem.title: UK: Texaco cuts Pembroke crude runs briefly due weathe.
newsitem.headline: Texaco cuts Pembroke crude runs briefly due weathe.

text.p: Texaco Inc said on Tuesday it reduced crude runs at its 180,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery at Pembroke in South Wales by about 15 percent due to delayed shipments of crude from the North Sea.
"Due to bad weather we reduced runs yesterday and today by about 15 percent but hope to be back to normal tomorrow," a Texaco spokeswoman said.
High winds and swell during the last couple of weeks have delayed tanker loadings at Britain's Sullom Voe Brent Blend terminal and Norway's Statfjord and Gullfaks systems which load offshore.
